item.title: BTSC Laboratory Assistant Vacancy 2026
item.description: Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) has released the Laboratory Assistant Recruitment 2026 notification for 1090 posts. Candidates having Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in relevant trade can apply online from 06/04/2026 to 06/05/2026. The selection will be done as per the official schedule. Interested candidates should check eligibility, age limit, application fee and apply before the last date.

item.title: Patna High Court Technical Assistant Vacancy 2026
item.description: Patna High Court has released the Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 notification for 53 vacancies. The online application process will start from 01 April 2026 and continue till 30 April 2026. Candidates with BCA / ITI / Diploma in relevant fields along with 1 year experience are eligible to apply.
